notes.title: Achievements Hotfix
notes.content:
Hello Lost Souls.

One of the secret achievements was not being unlocked when the requirements were met, this has been fixed now.

Hope you are able to Escape from the Nightmare and find your Delicious Food.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44818705/63b51aeca011f4bd8a77bb871752be46a6325ca2.png[/img]

notes.title: The Chained Door Will Be Opened
notes.content:
Hello lost souls.

The chained door can now be opened.

If you have escaped the Parking Lot and the Dark Forest, now is the time to face this final challenge.

Be Warned. 
It's difficult.

[list]
[*] 40 New Anomalies
[*] 2 New Achievements
[*] 1 Final Secret
[/list]

Your final challenge awaits you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44818705/814da8cb8cb792134f3734e8f0e02e2d4101d6a8.png[/img]

notes.title: A Dark Forest and a Chained Door
notes.content:
Hello lost souls.

For those who have escaped the Parking Lot a new path has opened. 

In this update you will be able to play in The Dark Forest, a new level with new anomalies.

You may need your flashlight for this one.

[list]
[*] 26 Small Anomalies
[*] 2 Dangerous Anomalies
[*] 3 New Achievements
[/list]

Be safe in the forest.


...


...


...

What lies behind the mysterious chained door?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44818705/814da8cb8cb792134f3734e8f0e02e2d4101d6a8.png[/img]

notes.title: New Anomalies have appeared!
notes.content:
Hello lost souls.

New [b]anomalies [/b]and [b]quality of life[/b] improvements have been added to the parking lot.

[list]
[*] 7 New Small Anomalies
[*] 1 New Dangerous Anomalies
[*] Option to disable walk/sprint camera movement
[/list]
